description: This file defines the PdfDate class, which encapsulates a PDF date value, providing methods to construct, format, and write PDF date strings.

classes.name: PdfDate
classes.description: Represents a direct date value in a PDF document, providing functionality to initialize, format, and output the date.

methods.name: PdfDate()
methods.description: Default constructor for creating a PdfDate instance with the current date/time or default.

methods.name: PdfDate(string value)
methods.description: Constructs a PdfDate by parsing a date string in PDF format.

methods.name: PdfDate(DateTime value)
methods.description: Constructs a PdfDate with a specific DateTime value.

methods.name: ToString()
methods.description: Returns the date in PDF date string format.

methods.name: WriteObject(PdfWriter writer)
methods.description: Writes the PDF date string to the PDF document via the provided writer.
